context:
From the course notes on hash tables:
  - Hash index formula: index = hash(key) % table_size
  - Two collision resolution strategies are covered: open addressing (specifically linear probing) and separate chaining.
  - The course emphasises that the load factor α (number of entries / table size) should be kept below 0.7 to maintain O(1) average performance.
  - Instructor note: Python's built-in dict uses open addressing with a load factor threshold of approximately 2/3, after which the table is resized.
  - Worst-case lookup degrades to O(n) when many collisions cluster (primary clustering in linear probing).
